Maya Singh: heads-up: staging sample-app started spitting schema parse errors after we flipped to the streaming fncall path with json mode.
Arjun Rao: can you paste the error? sounds like partial chunks hitting JSON.parse.
Maya Singh: snippet: \n[data] '{"call":{"name":"annotate","args":{"items":["a",'\n[data] '"b"]}}'\nvalidator: SyntaxError: Unexpected end of JSON input
Maya Singh: looks like the SDK validator tries to parse each data event. streaming emits fragments.
Greta Hofmann: short-term: add an SDK helper to collect a balanced top-level JSON value before validating. name suggestions: collectJsonFrame / jsonFrameCollector.
Arjun Rao: agree. constraints: detect balanced braces/brackets, handle escaped braces inside strings, maxBytes cap (128KB default) and maxWaitMs (250ms). if caps hit, emit partial frame with truncated flag.
Maya Singh: API sketch (TS): \nfor await (const ev of client.stream(...)) {\n  const frame = await collectJsonFrame(ev, {maxBytes: 128*1024, maxWaitMs: 250});\n  if (frame.partial) { /* app handles partial */ } else { validateSchema(JSON.parse(frame.payload)) }\n}
Greta Hofmann: parity: implement same semantics in python (async generator) and node. add unit tests for nested arrays, escaped quotes, NDJSON tool outputs, and fuzz chunk boundaries.
Arjun Rao: infra note: ensure validation is idempotent across retries so we don't double-log errors. also add telemetry: jsonframe_bytes, jsonframe_latency_ms, jsonframe_mode.
Maya Singh: I'll prototype TS helper behind a feature flag and update sample-app docs. Greta will take python mirror.
devex-bot: created issue #9400 "sdk: streaming json-frame collector + parity + telemetry" and auto-assigned Maya, Greta.
Greta Hofmann: will add integration test in sample-app harness and an onboarding note about streaming+json caveats.
Maya Singh: checklist: unit tests, node+py parity, docs, telemetry, feature flag, PR review. aiming to land draft PR tomorrow.
Arjun Rao: LGTM.
